text.tspan: Share of cereals allocated to human food vs. GDP per capita 2023
Share of domestic cereal supply allocated to direct human food, rather than animal feed or biofuels. GDP is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs across countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
